content:
ana (partnerships): Quick pulse — partners asking for a pre-announce window for H200 + MI300. Can we push an embargo offset by 2 weeks to avoid supply mismatch? Thoughts?
kevin (platform): sounds reasonable. main risk: Dedicated capacity bookings already committing next quarter. If we shift, need to notify sales + marketplace owners. @sophia FYI
marta (hw-ops): H200 shipments still constrained. MI300 batch arriving but firmware validation on pre-release silicon is taking longer. 2 weeks buys us time to finish certs.
sanjay (eng): We can route heavy inference to B200 fallback with quantized models for a short window. Perf will drop ~20% but latency SLOs can be kept with autoscale. Need to update routing policy: `route-policy: prefer-h200 -> fallback-b200`.
sophia (product): Good note. For marketplace listing we'll need new SKU tags and an "availability window" field. Can legal approve pre-announce marketing copy if dates are fuzzy? @kevin
marta (hw-ops): Legal loop is fine as long as we don't promise GA date. Suggest: "limited availability, subject to supply."
nora (sales): Sales here — keep us in the loop. We have 3 customers on EPD who asked for H200 access week-of-April. If embargo shifts, we need early access offers.
deploy-bot: inventory-check: H200 stock=low, MI300 incoming=2 shipments, Gaudi stock=medium
kevin (platform): Ops action items: (1) add temporary routing fallback (2) update marketplace SKU metadata (3) prepare an ops FAQ for SI partners. I can own 1+3.
marta (hw-ops): I'll handle firmware/cert timeline and give a firm go/no-go by EOD Thursday.
sophia (product): I'll draft the marketplace blurb and the short Q&A. Will ping legal.
nora (sales): thx — can we get a short matrix for customer-facing comms? 1-line for each config.
nora (sales): example: "H200: limited by supply; MI300: staggered availability; B200: generally available"
nora (sales): that works for now :+1:
kevin (platform): OK, syncing with partners on a 2-week offset unless any hard blockers. Keeping threads here. If anyone needs a voice call, propose 11am PST tomorrow.
marta (hw-ops): +1 for 11am PST
sanjay (eng): I'll be there, will bring routing config patch.
nora (sales): I'll invite key accounts
ana (partnerships): thanks all — I'll update partner PMs and draft the partner-facing note after the 11am sync.
